Alyssa (Sales): Quick Q from a pilot with EuroBank — they require EU + CA only processing, explicit tenant tagging, and BYOK per region. Want to run a short POC. Any blocking subprocessors or routing policy limits?
Jordan (SE): We can do tenant pinning to specific regions, but hosted BYOK is limited. Do they need BYOK keys in-customer HSMs per region?
Alyssa (Sales): Yes, KEKs in their HSMs; must not export keys across borders. Also they want a signed list of subprocessors and an egress certificate for firewall allowlisting.
Nina (Product): Product side: we have an affinity policy flag `region_affinity: strict` for pinned routing. Fallbacks can be `same-continent-only` or `any` — we should set to strict for this POC.
Chris (Infra): infra notes: 1) BYOK to customer HSM usually requires Dedicated or Private deployment with KMS peering; hosted won't meet non-export requirement. 2) Sticky tenant routing + strict pinning needs reserved capacity to avoid burst failover into other regions.
Rachel (Security): We can provide the subprocessors list and SOC/ISO artifacts. Attestation + contract addendum typically ~3-5 business days after we get customer's security pack and PO.
Alyssa (Sales): Practical ask: what's the rough pricing delta for reserved capacity + regional BYOK + attestation? Customer expects a ballpark this week.
Jordan (SE): Ballpark: regional pinning + BYOK = ~+30% on top of base Dedicated commit (very rough). Will confirm with finance for formal quote.
opsbot: New ticket created INF-PROC-2198 for "pinned-region BYOK POC". Assigned to: Chris (Infra), Jordan (SE).
Chris (Infra): For the POC I'll need: (1) sample tenant ID, (2) preferred region list (e.g., eu-west-1, ca-central-1), (3) certificate CN to add to egress allowlist, (4) a test CSR if they want mutual TLS.
Jordan (SE): Example routing headers we will use for the POC for their engineering team to stub in their side:
```
X-Redwood-Tenant: tenant-eurobank-01
X-Redwood-Region-Pref: eu-west-1,ca-central-1
X-Redwood-Pinning: strict
```
Nina (Product): Also recommend enabling KV-prefix caching for their conversational workload — reduces cross-region token fetches and keeps latencies low.
Alyssa (Sales): I'll add the sample tenant + preliminary SOW to the ticket and loop in legal. @Rachel (Security) I'll queue the attestation request and share the contact.
Rachel (Security): Ack. Please include their compliance contact and a primary legal POC. We'll start the subprocess attestation once we have their team contacts.
Alyssa (Sales): TL;DR: POC greenlight if finance ok with +~30% delta and legal signs the attestation. I'll push for an internal decision by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
Jordan (SE): I'll draft a minimal POC checklist (env, keys, certs, traffic patterns) and drop it in the ticket.
Chris (Infra): I can provision a reserved pool for the test once finance confirms the commit.
Alyssa (Sales): Thanks everyone — will update the ticket with contacts and next steps.
